_what: No page may hold another's fact, on either puzzle. THE STONE: the Reader has the four burnt shapes and never which way up, the Seer which way up and never a shape, the Listener where the lap ends and never a word, the Binder the two dated Laws and neither a shape nor a cut. THE DARK PATTERN: the Listener has the count and calls all twenty-four numbers and is told which are bells on none of them; the other three have SIX numbers each, no number on two lists, and every bell a single lane — so the union of two lists can never cover the third. This suite pins the six-number lists, because a list of eight with shared bells is the defect that made round three three-handed.
